title: When the Static Falls
author: Freya Winterbourne
blurb: Petra Underhill, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the fleet's truce expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
